meta.title: YC Atlas — 10 Years
meta.tagline: Every notable Y Combinator company and founder, Winter 2016 through Fall 2026.
about: A merged atlas spanning YC's full public history — the original curated Fall 2025/Winter 2026 batch plus ten years of mined, LLM-reviewed alumni.
Sorted by sphere of activity into ten sections, plus a Founders layer connecting people to the companies they built.
Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, press / to search.
